metadata.description: Likely represents the domain for setting cookies in the UI.
metadata.empty_value_implication: No cookie domain is set, which might lead to issues with cookie behavior.

suggestions: Specify a cookie domain to ensure proper cookie functionality.
If cookies are not required, confirm that this variable is unused.

metadata.description: Likely represents the name of the cookie used in the UI.
metadata.empty_value_implication: No cookie name is set, which might lead to issues with cookie identification.

suggestions: Specify a cookie name if cookies are required for functionality.
If cookies are not required, confirm that this variable is unused.

metadata.description: Defines the type of login integration used in the UI.
metadata.implication: This determines which login provider or mechanism is used.

suggestions: Ensure the login type is correctly configured to match your authentication integration.

metadata.description: Represents a password for accessing the site or application.
metadata.security_risks: This is sensitive information and should not be exposed publicly.
metadata.storage_recommendation: Store securely using environment variable encryption or a secret management tool.

suggestions: Ensure this password is stored securely and not exposed in logs or error messages.
Rotate passwords regularly to improve security.
Consider using a more complex password to increase strength.

metadata.description: Represents the username used to access the site or application, likely in email format.
metadata.security_risks: This is sensitive information and should be protected.
metadata.validation: Ensure the email format is correct and matches the expected domain.

suggestions: Ensure this username is stored securely and not exposed in logs or error messages.
Regularly audit accounts associated with this username for unauthorized access.
